title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance relocation payment rates (no-fault and Ellis Act evictions, 2026–27)
requirement: Landlords must pay relocation for no-fault evictions (owner/relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation) and Ellis Act evictions. For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $8,245.00 per tenant (max $24,733.00; +$5,497.00 elderly/disabled), or $11,110.05 per tenant under the Ellis Act (max $33,330.13; +$7,443.90).
coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation, or under the Ellis Act. Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days is governed by California Civil Code § 1947.9.

applicability.per_tenancy: Relocation is owed for owner/relative move-in, demolition, temporary capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation and Ellis Act evictions; the amount depends on the notice service date, with an extra amount for elderly (60+ or 62+) or disabled tenants.

exemptions: Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
